messages:
Mira Chen: Quick q — thinking about two low-key options for Saturday: evening sunset sail on the bay (we can fit ~6) or a cozy vinyl swap + tea at my place. Anyone in? :sailboat: :record_player:
Alex Rivera: Sail sounds incredible. What time would we head out?
Mira Chen: Planning to board around 5:30pm so we catch sunset. Meet at pier 7.
Jamie Patel: Vinyl swap is tempting too. I can bring a few jazz records. Can't do both but either works.
Tony Nguyen: Count me in for sail. Can help with a little cooler + snacks. 
Alex Rivera: @Mira Chen how long is the sail? I have a late dinner reservation at 8:30, want to make sure it fits.
Mira Chen: ~90 mins, should be fine if your reservation's flexible.
Jamie Patel: If a few people prefer vinyl we can do a 4pm swap and still make the 5:30 sail? (stretchy schedule)
Tony Nguyen: Hmm that’s tight. I’d prefer just the sail to avoid juggling.
Mira Chen: Cool. Right now sail has Alex, Tony, and me. Jamie leaning vinyl. Anyone else?
Sam (lunchbot): Reminder set: "Sunset Sail — meet Pier 7" at 17:00 on 1765526400. :bell:
Alex Rivera: Looks like @Luca and @Rina might be interested — pinged them.
Jamie Patel: If sail fills up, I'm down to host vinyl swap Sunday afternoon instead. 
Mira Chen: Love that. Ok plan: Saturday sail (priority to first 6) + Sunday vinyl at my place if sail's full. I'll post a short RSVP thread for who wants the sail. :thumbsup:
Tony Nguyen: Awesome, see y'all Saturday. I’ll bring tortilla chips and salsa.
Alex Rivera: I’ll bring thermos of hot chocolate (weather check). :hot_beverage:
Jamie Patel: Vinyl list incoming — I'll post titles so people can request trades.
Mira Chen: Perfect. Closing note — if anyone needs a ride from Mission, DM me. :)
